# C03 — Determination

## #0

Determination is the act through which a field becomes **this**: something can be distinguished, addressed, compared, remembered or acted upon. A distinction makes its terms available together, in a relation that lets one count as this and another as its alternative. It gives difference actual consequence.

[A01 — Faithful Definition](../A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **grounds** its first obligation: a definition must say something definite, and its defining act belongs to what it attempts to account for. C03 retains that act as a reusable operation. Its result is positive; a mark need not falsify what it discloses merely because the mark is finite.

## #1

The first distinction has two faces. It identifies something and makes the difference by which it can be identified. Saying “this” selects from a field while holding enough continuity for the selected instance to be recognised again. [A02 — Copula](../A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) **grounds** this double office in the name/instance/circumstance derivation. Repeating a name does not itself count its different bearers. Determination includes the individuation by which a name can reach anyone or anything at all.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/spencer-brown/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form.md|Spencer-Brown's Laws of Form]] **compares** this operation with marked/unmarked distinction in the calculus of indications. That calculus gives its unmarked state a formal office. QL's subject-condition is a further authorial development. The relation is **Resonant with** the source; its exact opening equations and re-entry passages still require locators.

## #2

To determine positively is also to exclude. What falls outside the selected term helps give it a boundary, even when the account does not name what it has excluded. “Not selected” cannot therefore mean “irrelevant to how the selection was made.”

[C18 — Apoha](C18-Apoha.md) **defines** the exclusion-side in its source-specific semantic register. [C17 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa](C17-Vikalpa-Samkalpa.md) **defines** the paired work of differentiating alternatives and gathering them into formative commitment. Negation denies; distinction lets terms differ; selection makes an alternative operative. Treating all three as rejection loses the positive world-making that the cut accomplishes.

The native `−/+` determination gives this work force. Withdrawal and extension remain co-present directions of a differentiating movement. A cut can become effective without its poles becoming independent substances.

## #3

A determination can recur as **another one of those**. In `X/x`, determining capacity becomes legible through a local instance, while the instance remains available to recurrence, comparison and change. The same letter in different cases keeps capacity and instance related. `X/x` is Taylor's notation; its psychological refractions do not originate it.

The [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md|core theorem spine]] **grounds** the sequence: parent `/ = −/−`; conscious circumstance `0/1`; question/assertion `?/!`; force `−/+`; recurrence `X/x`; personed context `AM/IS`; differential horizon `∞/dx`; return `1/0`. [A18 — Eight Determinations](../A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** its complete order and inversions. These are distinct joints of determining activity, not interchangeable glosses for a mark.

Measurement makes a further commitment: a unit, comparison or ratio renders a difference reckonable. [A15 — Ratio](../A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md) **extends** this operation. Precision belongs to the stated relation; it cannot promote a chosen measure into the source of everything it measures.

## #4

In `AM/IS`, what can be predicated meets the one for whom it matters through a relation of address. Body, memory, task, inherited language and concern participate in what becomes this object or this decision. [C08 — Context](C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) **defines** that horizon; [C14 — Māyā / Operative Measure](C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) **extends** the question into situated limitation.

An account of a selection becomes another selection. [C04 — Formal Limit](C04-Formal-Limit.md) **qualifies** determination at this point: the achieved form cannot absorb the act now accounting for it. The successful distinction remains; its determining condition has not become its possession.

## #5→0


Referential exclusion, finite figure and the native act of determination remain distinctly sourced positive operations; the [language history](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/language-symbol-dialogue/DEVELOPMENT.md#language-exclusion) **qualifies** this historical attribution.


The [zero-reception dossier](../../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/zero-reception.md#2--a-reception-story-also-requires-a-source) **qualifies** this operation. Nothaft’s current official-abstract card corrects the use of his article: its purpose is to challenge the familiar satanic-zero and ban narrative. The full article remains unread after a 403 response, so no individual medieval case is certified. This correction changes the next historical assertion while preserving the distinct mathematical operations. A claim stays determinate by naming what its available evidence can test.

A completed determination enters the inherited field of the next act. Return makes its source, criterion, exclusions and consequences available again. [C45 — Operational Parity](C45-Operational-Parity.md) **tests** the technical consequence: making the distinction explicit must change some actual operation if it is to claim operational efficacy. A label alone has not performed that return.

The [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account whole-field]] **grounds** the operational etymology relation. Name and count render a participant discriminable within a region; account becomes answerable when the region and participant can return to alter it. This is evidence register **3**, not common lexical descent. C03 **returns-to** [C02 — Faithful Definition](C02-Faithful-Definition.md): the distinction remains definite enough to use and related enough to answer for its use.

**Depth Restoration:** identification, exclusion, selection, recurrence, measurement, personed circumstance and return are recovered from core II(c), IV and XI, Draft3's opening, and the copula developmental chain. A08/C18 retain full apoha development; A09/C14 retain contraction; A10/A11 retain zero and the two unity-offices. No identity change.

**Unresolved Delta:** Spencer-Brown's exact equations and re-entry locators remain Open. External semantic, metaphysical and computational accounts retain their separate source tasks; this page's native operation is Argued from Taylor's development.
